# TPKELE - Solar DC & Low Voltage Protection Manufacturer

> IEC-certified DC MCB, DC SPD, PV combiner boxes, AC MCB, SPD, ATS and energy meters for solar installations in 100+ countries.

## Product Categories

- [DC Circuit Breakers](https://www.tpkele.com/products/category/mcb/dc-mcb): Solar DC miniature circuit breakers with arc-quenching design — up to 1500V DC
- [DC Surge Protectors](https://www.tpkele.com/products/category/spd/dc-spd): PV DC surge protectors for combiner boxes and inverter DC inputs — Type 1+2 / Type 2
- [PV Combiner Box](https://www.tpkele.com/products/combiner-box): IP65 PV combiner boxes pre-assembled with DC fuses, DC SPDs and DC breakers
- [AC Circuit Breakers](https://www.tpkele.com/products/category/mcb/ac-mcb): AC miniature circuit breakers, 1P–4P, 6–63A, B/C/D curves to IEC 60898-1
- [AC Surge Protectors](https://www.tpkele.com/products/category/spd/ac-spd): AC surge protective devices for distribution panels and inverter AC outputs
- [Automatic Transfer Switch](https://www.tpkele.com/products/ats): Dual-power automatic transfer switches for critical load transfer — PC & CB class
- [Voltage Protector](https://www.tpkele.com/products/voltage-protector): Voltage protectors monitor incoming mains and disconnect when line moves outside safe limits
- [Energy Meter](https://www.tpkele.com/products/energy-meter): DIN rail energy meters for distribution boards, sub-metering and tenant billing
